Growing up, my mom always bought one really special roll of wrapping paper each Christmas. It was thicker, more colorful, and a little more of a splurge than our usual wrapping paper. Every present from Santa was wrapped in it.

I couldn’t tell you what most of those presents were, but I remember the “Santa” paper. Not what it looked like, but how special it made everything feel.

And that’s exactly what I want my wrapping paper to be for you.

The paper you save for the special gifts. The ones you wrap with a little extra love. The ones you hope someone remembers years from now.

I only have a limited amount made each year, and this year’s designs are here! I’ll be bringing some along to my holiday events, too, so be sure to snag some now before it runs out.
